identity.name: Malicious .NET Compilation via Commonly Abused Process
identity.summary: An attacker uses a commonly abused process like PowerShell to invoke the .NET compiler (csc.exe) to compile and execute malicious code. Cortex should detect the unusual .NET compilation activity initi
identity.description: An attacker uses a commonly abused process like PowerShell to invoke the .NET compiler (csc.exe) to compile and execute malicious code. Cortex should detect the unusual .NET compilation activity initiated by a non-standard process.

payload.code: powershell.exe -Command "Add-Type -TypeDefinition 'using System; using System.Diagnostics; public class Test { public static void Main() { Process.Start("c:\\windows\\Microsoft.NET\\Framework\\v4.0.30319\\csc.exe", "/target:exe /out:C:\\temp\\malware.exe C:\\temp\\malicious.cs"); } }'"

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Possible malicious .NET compilation started by a commonly abused process
biocs.description: Detection of csc.exe execution initiated by a commonly abused process like PowerShell or cmd.exe
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name in ('powershell.exe', 'cmd.exe') and action_process_image_name = 'csc.exe'

abiocs.name: Unusual .NET compilation by PowerShell
abiocs.description: Detection of csc.exe being invoked from PowerShell with suspicious parameters
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'csc.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'csc.exe' and action_process_command_line contains '/target:exe'

xql_queries.name: Hunt for .NET compilation via PowerShell
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'csc.exe'
| fields actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_name, action_process_command_line
